description: 기후에너지환경부 한강홍수통제소_단기 침수단계 기준표(관심주의경계심각)_고정자료 [flood] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 기후에너지환경부 한강홍수통제소. 기후에너지환경부 한강홍수통제소의 단기 예측 기반 침수위험을 평가하기 위해 각 행정구역별로 관심·주의·경계·심각 단계별(10분,30분,60분,180분)기준을 제공하는 서비스이다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 기후에너지환경부 한강홍수통제소. Its tags are 누적시간, 행정구역별, 단계별, 10분, 30분. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-11-20 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
